entities.summary: Olga Dmitrievna Potachova is a Russian volleyball player. She was a member of the national team that won the silver medal in the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games. She is 2.04 metres tall, making her one of the tallest female athletes in the world. She had to retire in 2004 due to health problems.
